name: Green-Flame Blade

source.note: Entered from knowledge of Tasha's Cauldron of Everything (first printed in Sword Coast Adventurer's Guide), a 2014-rules spell the owner added on 2026-10-07; no 2024 book reprints it. Check every number against the owner's copy.

components.m: a melee weapon worth at least 1 SP

targets.description: One creature within 5 feet, struck with the component weapon; the fire may leap to a second creature within 5 feet of it.

cantrip_scaling.text: Extra Fire damage on a hit, none before level 5: 1d8 at level 5, 2d8 at 11, 3d8 at 17. The leaping fire adds the same dice to your spellcasting ability modifier.

summary: A melee weapon attack whose green fire leaps from the target to a second creature beside it.
text: Make one melee weapon attack against a creature within 5 feet, with the weapon you're casting through (it's the spell's material component) and that weapon's usual attack roll and damage. If it hits, you may send green flame from the target to another creature you can see within 5 feet of it; that creature takes Fire damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier. At character level 5 the hit adds 1d8 Fire damage and the jumping flame deals 1d8 + your modifier; at level 11 these are 2d8 and 2d8 + your modifier, and at level 17 3d8 and 3d8 + your modifier.
